operations.description: Illuminate continuously and acquire CCD time series. A Coherent Cube continuous-wave diode at 405 nm illuminates the sample. A simple lens gives an approximately circular focal spot. PL passes through a dichroic and spectral filter to a liquid-nitrogen-cooled Princeton Spec-10 CCD. Collect 20,000 frames with 100 ms integration and approximately 90 ms readout while constantly illuminated, giving slightly more than one hour total. SI S8 reports readout as 91 ms. Missing fields: exact power per specimen.

operations.description: Classify each dot/frame against background threshold and use ever-emitting population. Igor Pro groups pixels into dots, averages pixel intensity per dot and frame, and applies I_pix > BG + 2 sqrt(BG). I_pix is not background-subtracted. Below-threshold dots may remain discernible. Statistics use all dots that ever emitted, not every physical deposited particle. Main prose uses greater than 99% on-time over sixty minutes, while Figure 3 uses at least 99%. Retain the printed inequality distinction; denominator is dots that emitted at least once during observation. Missing fields: raw trajectories.
